mapper.sql: p.id, p.version_no, p.content, p.content_hash, p.status, p.note, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.published_by, p.published_at, p.is_deleted, p.deleted_at, p.deleted_by, c.base_version, c.base_hash, c.base_content, c.business_content, c.migration_source_version, c.migration_source_hash
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_prompt_version p LEFT JOIN ai_prompt_composition c ON c.version_no=p.version_no WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.version_no DESC
SELECT FROM ai_prompt_version p LEFT JOIN ai_prompt_composition c ON c.version_no=p.version_no WHERE p.version_no = #{versionNo} AND p.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_prompt_version p LEFT JOIN ai_prompt_composition c ON c.version_no=p.version_no WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ai_prompt_version p LEFT JOIN ai_prompt_composition c ON c.version_no=p.version_no WHERE p.status = 'DRAFT' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompt_composition newer JOIN ai_prompt_version np ON np.version_no=newer.version_no AND np.is_deleted=0 WHERE newer.version_no > p.version_no) ORDER BY p.version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM ai_prompt_version WHERE is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_prompt_version (version_no, content, content_hash, status, note, created_by, published_by, published_at) VALUES (#{versionNo}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_prompt_version SET content = #{content}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, note = #{note} WHERE version_no = #{versionNo} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE ai_prompt_version SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND version_no <> #{keepVersionNo} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE ai_prompt_version SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by = #{publishedBy}, published_at = NOW() WHERE version_no = #{versionNo} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'ARCHIVED') AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_prompt_version p LEFT JOIN ai_prompt_composition c ON c.version_no=p.version_no WHERE p.version_no=#{versionNo} AND p.is_deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_prompt_composition(version_no,base_version,base_hash,base_content,business_content, migration_source_version,migration_source_hash) SELECT #{versionNo},#{baseVersion},#{baseHash},#{baseContent},#{businessContent}, #{migrationSourceVersion},#{migrationSourceHash} FROM ai_prompt_version target WHERE target.version_no=#{versionNo} AND target.status='DRAFT' AND target.is_deleted=0 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_version=VALUES(base_version),base_hash=VALUES(base_hash), base_content=VALUES(base_content),business_content=VALUES(business_content)
